cards.title: Say yesterday

Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.
cards.name: Everyday English - A1 - Day 172 - Pronunciation & Listening - 01

articulation.label: yesterday
articulation.alt: yesterday: /j/ → /ɛ/ → /s/ → /t/ → /ɚ/ → /d/ → /eɪ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /j/: Front tongue high; glide into the next vowel.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
